value: Ashik, U. P. M., Wan Daud, W. M. A., & Abbas, H. F. (2015). Production of greenhouse gas free hydrogen by thermocatalytic decomposition of methane - A review. Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews, 44, 221-256. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rser.2014.12.025

NO TECHNOLOGY PARAMETERS EXTRACTED. A review of laboratory-scale research on thermocatalytic decomposition of methane (TCD): Tables 1-9 are catalyst compositions, reaction conditions, activation energies, hydrogen yields and regeneration results from bench experiments, with no process-scale energy use, cost, capacity or emissions. The paper states the technology 'is still in laboratory level' and not used industrially (p.223). Its process-level facts - reaction enthalpy 74.52 kJ/mol CH4 (Eq. 1) and >1200 degC for uncatalysed cracking (p.223) - match amin_2011_001's extraction, which already carries them. It quotes SMR process efficiency as 50% (p.223, ref [23]) in passing.

This is the paper IPCC AR6 WGIII Ch.11 Table 11.3 cites as 'Ashik et al 2015' (registered 2026-08-29 as ashik_2015_001, held from 2026-09-23). It replaces the 2017 review by Ashik, Wan Daud & Hayashi that was downloaded by mistake and registered for a day as ashik_2017_001 - that id and file were removed.
